Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
We are looking for a dedicated UC4 System Administrator & Support Specialist to manage, optimize and troubleshoot our enterprise workload automation environments. In this role, you will partner closely with internal customers to ensure seamless job scheduling, proactive incident resolution and continuous operational improvement.
Broadcom Automic Automation (formerly UC4) is a large-scale scheduling and automatization tool which allows you to plan, monitor, adapt, adjust and modify a variety of job types (SAP, UNIX, Windows etc.) and arrange and launch them in complex, interdependent structures.
Core Responsibilities:
 Lifecycle Management: Create, plan, maintain and optimize Automic (UC4) jobs across productive and test environments based on business and customer requirements.
 Operations & Monitoring: Actively monitor UC4 job execution, analyze workloads and ensure high availability and performance.
 Planning & Forecasting: Generate custom reports, capacity forecasts and schedules to accommodate upcoming system downtimes and maintenance windows.
 Calendar & Schedule Governance: Maintain and update UC4 calendars, system-specific events and scheduling dependencies.
 Downtime Coordination: Plan, schedule and monitor client and SAP system downtimes within the UC4 framework.
 Incident Management & Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis, resolve job failures and propose solutions.
 Consulting & Advisory: Partner with internal customers to consult, plan and implement new automation requests effectively.
 Technical Support: Provide expert 2nd- and 3rd-level support via enterprise ticketing systems.
 Service Excellence: Drive continuous improvement of UC4 service operations, automation workflows and operational efficiency.
 Qualifications & Skills Required:
 Education: Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable technical field (a strong plus).
 Language Proficiency: Fluency in English (spoken and written) is mandatory. Familiarity with German is beneficial, though not mandatory.
 Domain Experience: Background or familiarity with SAP or MRP environments is an advantage.
 Technical Foundation: Practical knowledge of Linux scripting and proficiency with standard MS Office tools.
 Problem-Solving & Work Ethic: Strong analytical mindset with exceptional prioritization skills and a proactive approach to troubleshooting.
 Collaboration & Communication: Outstanding communication skills, strong customer focus and the ability to thrive both independently and within a collaborative team.
 Mindset: High eagerness to learn, adapt and grow in a fast-paced enterprise IT environment.
 About Siemens
